landing.title: From field to market, with every step on record

chain.title: My batches (KrishiChain)
chain.intro: Each batch keeps an append-only record of what happened to it. Share its QR code so buyers can check the history.
chain.split_hint: e.g. 6, 4 — must not exceed the batch quantity
chain.verified_meaning: This shows the record has not been altered since it was written. It is not a quality or safety certificate.
chain.broken_detail: The record does not match from event #{seq} onwards ({reason}).
chain.reason_broken_link: the link between events was changed
chain.reason_missing_or_reordered: an event is missing or out of order
chain.correction_done: Correction added — the original stays visible
chain.qr_hint: Print or share this code. Scanning it opens a public page with the batch history — no names or phone numbers.
chain.link_hint: Linked batches record this step in their history.

screen.title: Crop photo check
screen.tips: Photograph one leaf, in daylight, centred, on a plain background if possible. This gives a possible condition, not a diagnosis.
screen.photo_hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. Resized on your phone before upload.
screen.crop_not_supported: Photo checks are available for potato and tomato only for now.
screen.looks_healthy: Looks healthy — no known disease pattern found
screen.not_diagnosis: This is a possible condition from an AI model, not a diagnosis. Confirm with your local KVK or agriculture officer before treating.
screen.unsure_low_confidence: The model is not confident enough about this photo.
screen.unsure_not_this_crop: To the model, this photo does not look like a {crop} leaf.
screen.unsure_next: Retake the photo (one leaf, daylight, centred) or consult your local KVK.
screen.lim_possible_condition_not_diagnosis: A possible condition, never a diagnosis.
screen.lim_lab_trained_model: Trained mostly on lab photos; much less reliable on field photos.
screen.lim_single_leaf_daylight: Works best with one leaf, in daylight.
screen.lim_confirm_with_kvk: Confirm with your KVK before any treatment.
screen.model_facts: Model: open-source MobileNetV2 (Apache-2.0). Lab accuracy 99%, but only about 16% on a small set of real field photos — that is why it often says “Not sure”.

guidance.none: No sourced guidance for this condition yet. Please consult your local KVK.
guidance.varieties: Resistant varieties named by the source
guidance.varieties_note: check suitability for your area with your KVK
guidance.chemicals_note: No doses are given here — follow the product label and your KVK's advice.
guidance.translation_draft: Translation is a draft awaiting review.

advisory.title: Advisories
advisory.disclaimer: Advisories compare the forecast with conditions published by the cited source. They are prompts to inspect your field, not predictions of disease.
advisory.none: No advisories for the next 48 hours.
advisory.rain_evidence: {mm} mm forecast on {date} (IMD band starts at {threshold} mm in 24 h).
advisory.hours_evidence: {n} of the next {window} hours match {cond}; {rain} mm rain forecast in that window.
advisory.action: Inspect your crop more often for early symptoms.

net.title: Where should I sell?
net.intro: Compares the nearest markets: expected sale value at the latest modal price minus your transport cost and fees. Enter your own costs — they are your assumptions.
net.rate: Transport cost (₹ per km per quintal)
net.practical_hint: Markets farther than this are flagged.
net.none: No markets with a known position and price for this crop.
net.assumptions: Assumptions: {qty}, transport {rate} per km per quintal, fees {fees}%, practical distance {km} km.
net.disclaimer: Estimates only: prices are from the date shown and may have changed; distances are by road (OSRM) or a straight-line estimate.

freshtrack.title: FreshTrack — storage conditions
freshtrack.intro: Readings are compared with the cited safe band for the crop in each zone. Alerts explain what was seen and what to inspect; an alert is a prompt to check, not a food-safety verdict.
freshtrack.need_zone: Add a zone to a facility first.
freshtrack.no_profile: No cited storage band for this zone's crop — only sensor checks (stale, implausible) run.
freshtrack.simulated_note: Small dots are simulated readings from the demo simulator.
freshtrack.reading_with_alert: Reading saved — an alert was raised or updated
freshtrack.no_my_alerts: No alerts on your stored produce.
freshtrack.still_active: The condition is still present. Bring it back into range and record a normal reading before resolving.
freshtrack.findings_hint: e.g. door seal leaking, compressor tripped
freshtrack.corrective_hint: e.g. replaced seal, restarted unit, checked product
freshtrack.profile_hint: Pick seed / table / processing where it applies.
freshtrack.explain_temp_high: Above {threshold} °C for {minutes} min (since {start}; peak {peak} °C). Safe band {band} for {profile}.
freshtrack.explain_temp_low: Below {threshold} °C for {minutes} min (since {start}; lowest {peak} °C). Safe band {band} for {profile}.
freshtrack.explain_rh_high: Humidity above {threshold}% for {minutes} min (since {start}; peak {peak}%). Safe band {band} for {profile}.
freshtrack.explain_rh_low: Humidity below {threshold}% for {minutes} min (since {start}; lowest {peak}%). Safe band {band} for {profile}.
freshtrack.explain_implausible: The sensor reported {peak} °C at {latest}, which looks implausible ({reasons}).
freshtrack.explain_unusual: {peak} °C at {latest} is unusual compared with recent readings (mean {mean} °C, beyond {sigma} standard deviations). Information only.
freshtrack.explain_stale: No reading for {minutes} min (expected at least every {threshold} min). Last reading {start}.
freshtrack.inspect_temp_high: Check: door seals and door discipline, refrigeration unit and evaporator, product core temperature, air circulation.
freshtrack.inspect_temp_low: Check: thermostat set-point, defrost cycle, product for chilling or freezing damage.
freshtrack.inspect_rh_high: Check: condensation, drainage, ventilation; look for wet or mouldy produce.
freshtrack.inspect_rh_low: Check: humidifier or water supply, door openings; look for shrivelling or weight loss.
freshtrack.inspect_implausible: Check the sensor (placement, cable, battery) before acting on this value.
freshtrack.inspect_unusual: Investigation signal only: compare with a handheld thermometer.
freshtrack.inspect_stale: Check the sensor and its connection, or enter a manual reading.

demo.intro: Demo controls create simulated readings and alerts, clearly labelled. Every action is recorded in the audit log.
demo.no_alert_yet: No alert yet — the excursion is shorter than the warning threshold.
demo.minutes_ahead: Check stale sensors as if this many minutes later
demo.minutes_ahead_hint: 0 = real time. Alerts from a time-advanced check are marked simulated.
demo.flood_hint: Triggers a SIMULATED flood polygon, finds affected records and proposes relocations. Nothing moves until a person confirms.
demo.flood_result: Affected: {farms} farms, {stores} cold stores, {lots} stored lots.

emergency.title: Emergency coordination
emergency.simulated_label: Simulated scenario — not a forecast or a real flood extent
emergency.summary: Affected: {farms} farms, {stores} cold stores, {lots} stored lots, {upcoming} upcoming bookings (triggered {time}).
emergency.legend: Map: red outline = scenario area · green = farms · red = exposed cold stores · blue = candidate stores · pale circles = forecast rainfall (Open-Meteo).
emergency.confirm_q: Request a booking at {name} for this lot? Its operator still has to accept it.
emergency.confirmed: Booking request sent to the target store
emergency.request_sent: Booking request sent — the target store's operator decides. Nothing has moved yet.
emergency.no_options: No store outside the area currently takes this crop with enough free space.
emergency.simulated_note: Illustrative polygon drawn for this demonstration. It is not a flood forecast, a hazard map, or a real flood extent.
emergency.ranking_note: Options are cold stores outside the scenario area that take this crop and have enough free space, nearest by road first.
emergency.urgency_note: Lots are ordered by perishability (tomato, then potato, then rice/jute) — an Irminsul assumption.
emergency.cost_note: Cost is shown only when you enter your own transport rate.
